hypotheses.reconstruction_rule: G0003 is recovered as identity[F]=K(n,m); G0004 is recovered as substitution[F, m->n]=K(n,n).
required_assumptions: K is a common bivariate applied undefined function symbol in the catalog
hypotheses.scientific_rationale: Both catalog members are applications of the same arity-2 undefined function K; the diagonal branch K(n,n) is obtained from K(n,m) by the variable substitution m->n. This is a structural substitution family, not a physical model.
